Eldritch is a pretty strong stealth/horror game. Movement feels like an alternate-universe Dishonored that came out in 1999, and the enemies themselves are numerous, menacing, and tough. Receiver is a frigid bitch, but a loving one. More of a Gun Simulator than an FPS, it turns successfully pegging an enemy robot and reloading smoothly into achievements by themselves. I think mouse gestures would have served the mechanics better than the many different key inputs you're required to muscle-memorize.

Good if you just want some Quakish shooting galleries, but if you want that, is anything other than Quake really gonna hit that itch? Get it, but get it on sale.
